manualModeContract.replace: Replace actor with these visible or offscreen lower-body joints. No inferred upper body for foot inserts.
manualModeContract.fragment: Overlay only explicit connected limb segments if that fragment is absent from automated detection; never draw duplicate limbs. Missing joints remain absent.
manualModeContract.visible: false represents limb outside the image; use it for time-bound appearance.
manualModeContract.joints: Normalized UV; append depth separately. Toe is shoe front, ankle is shoe rear/top.
manualModeContract.scope: scope=fullbody replaces the entire actor track with explicit named COCO joints. Cropped upper-body overrides may omit knees/ankles; omitted joints must remain absent, not inferred.
manualModeContract.actorVisibility: Per-shot actorVisibility ranges override lingering automatic tracks. These ranges only suppress invisible actors and do not alter earlier measured actions.
